name: Reith im Alpbachtal
kurzbeschreibung: Charming village nestled between Alpbach and Brixlegg, featuring one of the most beautiful Alpachtal valleys in Tirol and the breathtaking Tratzberg Panorama.
beschreibung:
Überblick

Reith im Alpbachtal is situated in the Kufstein district on a sunny plateau at the gateway to the Alpbachtal valley at 637 metres above sea level, home to roughly 2,900 residents. The municipality stretches from the valley floor of the Inn River to the summit of the Reither Kogel at 1,336 metres. Crowned as the Most Beautiful Floral Village in Europe with a gold medal at the Entente Florale, Reith enchants travellers with timber balconies laden with colourful flowers. At the village heart lies Lake Reither See, known as the blue eye of the village, creating a peerless family holiday and wellness destination.

Geschichte

Reith is among the earliest documented communities in the Lower Inn Valley, appearing around 976 AD in Salzburg's Codex Fridarici under the name Riute, meaning cleared forest land. Between the 15th and 19th centuries, silver and copper mining flourished around the Reither Kogel, partially financed by the powerful Augsburg Fugger merchant family. Medieval Schloss Matzen castle with its Romanesque butter-churn tower was acquired in 1873 by the Anglo-Austrian Baillie-Grohman family, who created the adjacent 200,000-square-metre Matzen Park, one of western Austria's foremost English landscape gardens. The parish church of St. Peter was redesigned in 1805 in early neoclassical style, featuring frescoes by Joseph Schöpf and a historic 1560 bronze bell cast by master founder Gregor Löffler.

Anreise

Reaching Reith im Alpbachtal is easy and stress-free. Motorists follow the Inntalautobahn A12 to the Kramsach/Alpbachtal exit, turning onto the L5 Alpbachtal state road at the roundabout to reach the village after just three kilometres. Rail travellers take the Austrian Federal Railways (ÖBB) along the Lower Inn Valley railway to the nearby Brixlegg station, only 2.5 kilometres away. From Brixlegg station forecourt, VVT regional bus line 4074 whisks passengers directly into the village centre and to the Reitherkogelbahn cable car in less than seven minutes.

Tipps

During the warmer months, Lake Reither See in the village centre offers swimming lawns, diving boards, and a lakeside cafe for refreshing breaks. The Reitherkogelbahn gondola ascends directly to the family adventure mountain, where the Juppi Zauberwald enchanted circular trail features a barefoot path, viewing tower, and play areas accessible for pushchairs. Walkers should explore the protected Matzen Park surrounding Schloss Matzen with picturesque ponds and ancient oak trees. Gourmets will enjoy the Alpbachtaler Heumilchkäserei dairy, sampling artisan cheeses made from fresh hay milk. In late September, the traditional Reith Cattle Drive (Almabtrieb) delights visitors with flower-crowned cattle, folk music, and local markets.
